mapper.insert: INSERT INTO script_marketing_send_record (tenant_id, task_id, group_id, step_index, account_id, command_id, status, reason, message_id, submitted_at, finished_at, result_deadline_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{taskId}, #{groupId}, #{stepIndex}, #{accountId}, #{commandId}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{messageId}, #{submittedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{resultDeadlineAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM script_marketing_send_record WHERE group_id=#{groupId} AND step_index=#{stepIndex}
mapper.update: UPDATE script_marketing_send_record SET status=#{status}, reason=#{reason}, message_id=#{messageId}, submitted_at=#{submittedAt}, finished_at=#{finishedAt}, result_deadline_at=#{resultDeadlineAt} WHERE id=#{id}
